title: Contract reservation buckets and per-contract allocation plan Q1 2026
content:
Sheet: Contract Reservation Buckets (flat export)
Generated by: Maya Chen (infra capacity) — working draft for ops review

Columns:
ContractID | Customer | Region(s) | GPU_Type | Reserved_GPUs | Bucket_ID | Start | End | Util_Target_% | Current_Util_% | Peak_Week_GH | Notes / constraints

Rows:
CR-1009 | TeraVault | us-west1 | A100-80GB | 48 | bucket-W-1 | 2026-01-01 | 2027-01-01 | 75 | 63 | 1.8M | Strict SLA: 99.9% throughput. No cross-region fallback without approval
CR-1022 | Nimbus Health | eu-west1 | H100-80GB | 32 | bucket-E-2 | 2026-02-15 | 2026-11-30 | 70 | 58 | 1.1M | Regulated data; must remain in eu region. Support on-call: Lina
CR-1015 | Adverly | us-central1,us-east1 | A100-80GB | 24 | bucket-US-FLEX-3 | 2026-01-15 | 2026-07-15 | 60 | 45 | 0.6M | Flexible routing allowed; prefers cheaper region under cost-smoothing policy
CR-1033 | FinGrid | ap-southeast1 | H100-80GB | 16 | bucket-AP-4 | 2026-03-01 | 2027-03-01 | 80 | 82 | 0.4M | High utilization; flagged for potential burst to dedicated spare pool on 2026-03-15
CR-1040 | EduCloud | us-west1 | A100-40GB | 8 | bucket-W-5 | 2026-01-20 | 2026-12-31 | 50 | 20 | 0.12M | Low utilization; consider lease reassign in Q2 if trend continues
CR-1002 | Atlas Search | global (multi-region) | A100-80GB | 64 | bucket-M-0 | 2026-01-01 | 2026-12-31 | 78 | 70 | 2.2M | Multi-region pin; fallbacks: eu-west1->us-west1 latency degrade allowed for read-only workloads
CR-1051 | DeepRetail | eu-west1 | A100-80GB | 12 | bucket-E-6 | 2026-02-01 | 2026-08-01 | 55 | 40 | 0.18M | Short term trial; use preemptible spare capacity when possible

Summary metrics (Q1 snapshot):
Total reserved GPUs (active contracts listed): 216
Reserved by type: A100-80GB: 176 | H100-80GB: 48 | A100-40GB: 8
Regional breakdown: us-west1: 88 | eu-west1: 56 | us-central/east combined: 24 | ap-southeast1: 16 | multi:32
Weighted utilization (current): 68% average across buckets (method: sum(current_util_pct*reserved)/sum(reserved))
Forecasted additional requests next 90d: 3 contracts (expected +120 GPUs) — see linked JIRA backlog

Allocation rules & decision log (working):
- Priority tiers: Tier 1 (SLA critical, non-failover): 99% availability target. Tier 2 (regulated but allowed failover): 95%. Tier 3 (flex/burstable) subject to cost-smoothing.
- Bucket assignment logic: prefer in-region pins when contract requires compliance. Use bucket-US-FLEX for elastic customers to maximize packing.
- Smoothing policy formula (applied nightly): target_per_region = floor((committed * 1.05 + spare_pool*0.15) / gpu_unit) — implemented in infra scheduler (see PR above).
- Fallback policy: when a bucket utility > util_target + 15% and spare_pool < 10% of global capacity, initiate canary overflow to compatible buckets; notify owners with 30m SLA.

Short-term action items (owner, ETA):
- Confirm burst window for FinGrid (CR-1033). Owner: Ravi Singh. ETA: 2026-02-10.
- Re-assess EduCloud (CR-1040) utilization; propose shrink or marketplace reassign if below 30% for 8 consecutive weeks. Owner: Maya. ETA: 2026-04-01.
- Add 64 H100s to ap-southeast spare pool for anticipated retail pilot in Q2. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2026-03-15.
- Implement per-bucket telemetry tag to track KV-cache hits and average seq_len per token. Owner: infra-telemetry. Linked ticket: JIRA-ENGINF-3479. ETA: 2026-02-28.

Operational notes / constraints:
- Maintenance blackout windows: monthly first-Sunday 0200-0600 UTC for firmware across us-west1 clusters. Mark buckets with "maintenance-safe" flag if workloads can tolerate rolling restarts.
- KMS/HSM considerations: Nimbus Health buckets are on customer-managed KMS; rebalancing requires key policy review and 7-day lead time.
- Cost implications: A100-80GB per-month cost (on reserved pricing) used for internal unit economy is $5,100/GPU/month; H100-80GB is $7,200/GPU/month. Use these for internal chargeback runs.

Suggested rebalancing strategy (for next 6 weeks):
- Move 8 A100s from bucket-W-5 (EduCloud) -> bucket-US-FLEX-3 on 2026-03-01 if EduCloud remains <25% util; update contract amendment before move.
- Prepare cold-standby group of 32 A100s in us-west1 to serve as immediate overflow for Atlas Search multi-region spikes. Schedule capacity check 2026-02-20.

Spreadsheet appendix (operational formulas used in sheet):
- Weighted_util = sum(Current_Util_% * Reserved_GPUs) / sum(Reserved_GPUs)
- Spare_pool_pct = (Total_free_GPUs_across_clusters) / (Total_deployed_GPUs) * 100
- Cost_per_effective_gpu = (monthly_reserved_cost * 1.0) / (Reserved_GPUs * Util_Target_% )

Open questions (to discuss on 02/05 ops sync):
- Approve adding H100 capacity to AP region vs moving existing contracts to US regions for cost reasons? Trade-off: latency/regulatory risk vs unit cost.
- Are we comfortable with automating 8-week reassign for low-util customers or keep manual approvals?

Change log (short):
- 2026-01-10: initial export (Maya)
- 2026-01-22: added FinGrid burst plan and cost figures (Ethan)
- 2026-02-03: updated utilization snapshot and action items (Maya)

Notes to reviewers:
- This is a working planning sheet intended to feed dedicated capacity forecasts and the monthly forecasting pipeline. Please add comments inline in Drive; high level approvals required from infra-ops and legal for any cross-region reassignment of regulated contracts.

End of sheet export.
